cards.audioText: Your call sign is CCA1432, destination Beijing. You are just handed to Beijing Approach, and maintaining 4200m with information S, your squawk code is 1026, contact Beijing Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是国航1432，目的地北京。你刚刚移交给北京进近，你现在正保持在4200米，收到通播S，你的应答机编码是1026，联系北京进近。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA1432, destination Beijing, maintaining 4200m with information S, squawk 1026.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，国航1432，目的地北京，正保持在4200米，通播S，应答机1026。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1432, Beijing Approach, radar identified, expect IKUBA-1A arrival and expect ILS approach runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航1432，北京进近，雷达看见了，预计IKUBA-1A进近，预计盲降进近跑道18左。
cards.referenceText: IKUBA-1A arrival, runway 18L, CCA1432.
cards.referenceTextZh: IKUBA-1A进近，跑道18左，国航1432。

cards.audioText: Your weather radar shows that there is a thunderstorm developing near your destination, and it will affect your flight, you want to know your approach time.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的气象雷达显示雷暴在你目的地机场附近形成，这将影响你的飞行，你想知道你的进近时间。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA1432, request approach time.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，国航1432，请求进近时间。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA1432, expect 15 minutes delay, expect approach time 0345.
[Because of the bad weather, you want to land as soon as possible.]
cards.audioTextZh:
国航1432，预计延误15分钟，预计进近时间0345分。
【由于恶劣天气，你想尽量着陆】
cards.referenceText: Request to land as soon as possible, CCA1432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求尽快着陆，国航1432。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1432, negative, you have traffic at 12 o'clock and 5 miles, he is the number 1 for runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航1432，不可以，你12点钟方向5海里有航空器，他第一个落地跑道18左。
cards.referenceText: Roger, CCA1432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，国航1432。

cards.audioText: Your weather radar shows a strong echo from the thunderstorm ahead. So you want radar vectors to go round the weather, ask for Beijing Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的气象雷达显示前方雷暴有很强回音。你想要雷达引导绕飞天气，请求北京进近。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA1432, request radar vectors to go round the weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，国航1432，请求雷达引导，绕飞天气。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1432, turn right heading 320, continue descend and maintain 3600m on standard.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航1432，右转航向320，继续按标压下到3600米保持。
cards.referenceText: Right heading 320, continue descend and maintain 3600m on standard, CCA1432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向320，继续按标压下到3600米保持，国航1432。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1432, turn right direct to BOBAK(霸州).
cards.audioTextZh: 国航1432，右转直飞BOBAK。
cards.referenceText: Right direct to BOBAK, CCA1432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞BOBAK，国航1432。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 1432, continue descend and maintain 2400m on QNH 1006, reduce speed to 203 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航1432，继续下降到2400保持，QNH1006，速度降至203节。
cards.referenceText: Continue descend and maintain 2400m on QNH 1006, reduce speed to 203 knots, CCA1432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续下降到2400保持，QNH1006，速度降至203节，国航1432。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1432, turn left heading 360, contact Tower on 119.0, good day.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航1432，左转航向360，联系塔台119.0，再见。
cards.referenceText: Left heading 360, contact Tower on 119.0, good day, CCA1432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向360，联系塔台119.0，再见，国航1432。

cards.audioText: You are 17nm from the airport, but the weather is deteriorating, so you want to perform straight-in ILS approach runway 18L, inform Beijing Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在距离机场17海里，但是天气恶化，所以你想直接盲降进近跑道18左，联系北京塔台。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA1432, request straight-in ILS approach runway 18L (due weather).
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，国航1432，（由于天气）请求直接盲降进近直接进近跑道18左。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1432, Beijing Tower, cleared straight-in ILS approach runway 18L, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航1432，北京塔台，可以直接盲降进近跑道18左，建立后报。
cards.referenceText:
Cleared straight-in ILS approach runway 18L, wilco, CCA1432.
注：题干中的report established可以用wilco代替。
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以直接盲降进近跑道18左，照办，国航1432。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA1432, say speed, seems like you are overtaking traffic.
[Tell the controller your speed is 180 knots.]
cards.audioTextZh:
国航1432，报告速度，看起来你要超过前方航空器了。
【告知管制员，你的速度是180节。】
cards.referenceText: Speed 180 knots, CCA1432.

cards.audioText:
C: CCA1432, can you reduce to 160 knots? You are losing separation with the preceding aircraft, I show you only 4 miles behind.
[Tell the controller you can not accept 160 knots, because 180 knots is your minimum clean speed.]
cards.audioTextZh:
国航1432，你可以降低速度至160节吗？你与前机失去间隔，我看你只在他后方4海里。
【告知管制员你无法接收160节，因为180节是你的最低光洁速度。】
cards.referenceText:
Negative, unable to maintain 160 knots, 180 knots is our minimum clean speed, CCA1432.
注：此处建议使用Negative, unable to... due这个结构来表示“由于。..无法。..”这一含义。
cards.referenceTextZh: 不可以，不能保持160节，180节是我们最小的光洁速度了，国航1432。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, CCA1432, start S turns now and report when you can maintain 160 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，国航1432，开始S转弯，可以保持160节后报。
cards.referenceText:
S turns now and wilco, CCA1432.
注：题干中Report when... 这样的指令，都可以用wilco来回答。
cards.referenceTextZh: S转弯，照办，国航1432。

cards.audioText: Now you have intercepted the localizer runway 18L, report to Beijing Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你截获了跑道18左的航向道，报告给北京塔台。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA1432, intercept the localizer runway 18L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，国航1432，截获了跑道18左的航向道。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1432, continue present heading, descend and maintain 600m, cleared ILS approach runway 18L, report outer marker.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航1432，继续保持当前航向，下到600米保持，可以盲降进近跑道18左，外指点信标后报。
cards.referenceText: Continue present heading, descend and maintain 600m, cleared ILS approach runway 18L, wilco, CCA1432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续保持当前航向，下到600米保持，可以盲降进近跑道18左，照办，国航1432。

cards.audioText: You are now over outer marker.
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在已经过了外指点信标台。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA1432, outer marker.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，国航1432，过外指点信标台。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1432, cleared to land, runway 18L, surface wind 170, 13m/s, QNH1006, caution bad weather in the vicinity of the airport, the RVR is significantly reduced.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航1432，可以落地，跑道18左，地面风170度，13米每秒，QNH1006，注意机场附近有恶劣天气，跑道视距严重降低。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land, runway 18L, QNH1006, roger caution, CCA1432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以落地，跑道18左，QNH1006，收到注意，国航1432。

cards.audioText: The thunderstorm clouds obscured the runway threshold, you can not get the visual contact of the runway, you want to know if you can change to land on runway 18R.
cards.audioTextZh: 雷暴云盖住了跑道入口，你无法目视跑道，你想知道你能否着陆到跑道18右。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA1432, request change to land on runway 18R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，国航1432，请求更改至跑道18右着陆。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA1432, Beijing Tower, negative, runway 18R is closed due to dissipating thunderstorm, advise go-around, state intention.
[Tell the controller that you have no choice and you will execute go around procedure.]
cards.audioTextZh:
国航1432，北京塔台，不可以，跑道18右由于消散雷暴关闭，建议复飞，告知意图。
【告知管制员你没有别的选择，将执行复飞程序。】
cards.referenceText:
Going around, CCA1432.
注：飞行员执行复飞程序，可直接用going around表示。
cards.referenceTextZh: 复飞了，国航1432。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1432, roger, cancel approach, follow the published missed approach procedure, turn right heading 300, climb and maintain 900m, report reaching.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航1432，收到，取消进近，按照发布的复飞程序，右转航向300，上到900米保持，到达后报。
cards.referenceText: Cancel approach, follow the published missed approach procedure, turn right heading 300, climb and maintain 900m, wilco, CCA1432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 取消进近，按照发布的复飞程序，右转航向300，上到900米保持，照办，国航321。

cards.audioText: You want to join the holding area for about 20 minutes until the weather improves, and then attempt another approach, inform Tower controller.
cards.audioTextZh: 你想加入等待区域大约20分钟，直到天气变好，然后尝试再次进近，告知塔台管制。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA1432, request join the holding area for about 20 minutes until the weather improves, and then attempt another approach.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，国航1432，请求等待区域大约20分钟，直到天气变好，然后尝试再次进近。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1432, hold over VM 3600m, holding inbound track 110 degrees, left hand pattern, outbound time one and a half minutes, expect further ATC clearance in 10 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航1432，在VM 台等待，高度3600米，向台航迹110度，左等待，背台时间1分半，预计10分钟后有进一步指令。
cards.referenceText: Hold over VM 3600m, holding inbound track 110 degrees, left hand pattern, outbound time one and a half minutes, CCA1432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在VM 台等待，高度3600米，向台航迹110度，左等待，背台时间1分半，国航1432。
